about: Held-out question set (2026-11-25, R7.14). Written after the lexicon and ranking were tuned on registry_questions.json and never used to tune them, so its score estimates coverage on questions the tuning did not see. Synthetic, not from real users. Same fields as registry_questions.json. First run 2026-11-25: 54 of 60 strong (90%), the honest estimate. Its six misses were then fixed in the lexicon, so the set is now spent: write a fresh one before the next measurement.
